title: 50 Sea Otters Survived And Kelp Became A Carbon Shield
hook: A nearly erased predator returned with climate consequences.
closing: Protecting one predator can strengthen an entire coastline and its carbon storage.
question: Would you welcome otters nearby?

segments.say: Only 50 California sea otters remained. Fur trading nearly erased the population.
California sea otters recovered to 3,000. That comeback restored a predator linked to healthier kelp forests.
Otter-protected kelp could store 8.7 million metric tons of CO2 yearly. The comeback can strengthen a major carbon sink.
